method: Each definition in s10-review-fixes-mutation-defs.json applied alone by exact text replacement, its named test run alone (vitest -t), every touched file restored and compared by SHA-256, then the test rerun. Integration tests run on local PostgreSQL with the real schema built from the migrations, as envoi_web; merchant accounts are created by the operator functions with passwords generated in memory per run, and their FIXTURE shops are created through the merchant routes. Every SGQR payload is a FIXTURE built tag by tag; none is an authentic sticker. The review fixes add no migration; the scan result unit test renders the result component to static markup. A proof also needs the mutated run to fail on an AssertionError.

results.test: the request body is bounded at 4 KiB
results.mutation: Raise the 4 KiB request body bound to 4 MB; the test fails.
results.error: AssertionError: expected 200 to be 400 // Object.is equality

results.test: one outlet carrying two mapped identifiers is one candidate
results.mutation: Select every matching identifier row instead of one row per outlet; the test fails.
results.error: AssertionError: expected { kind: 'ambiguous', …(1) } to deeply equal { kind: 'single', outlet: { …(4) } }

results.test: a shared identifier lists at most 20 outlets, by name
results.mutation: Drop the bound of 20 candidates; the test fails.
